note: CRITICAL ORDERING: release must be sub-call index 0, revokeGrant must be sub-call index 1. Both execute within the same Ethereum transaction — same block, same block.timestamp.

execution_mechanism.instruction: In Safe UI: New Transaction → Transaction Builder → add sub-call 0 (release) → add sub-call 1 (revokeGrant) → Create Batch → Execute
execution_mechanism.why_same_block: Safe executes the batch as a single execTransaction call, which delegates to MultiSend. All sub-calls occur within one Ethereum tx and share block.timestamp.

expected_outcome.release_effect: g.released written to vested_at_T = floor(1000 * (T - 1759547342) / 31536000). Tokens minted to beneficiary.
expected_outcome.revokeGrant_reads_updated_released: revokeGrant reads g.released from storage, observing the value written by release() in the same tx (A2 assumption).

failure_condition.if_claimable_neq_zero: revokeGrant read stale g.released (pre-release value of 0) instead of updated value — would indicate A2 violation or storage isolation bug
failure_condition.numeric_contradiction: If claimable > 0, then released + claimable + canceled would still equal 1000 (conservation holds) but claimable should be 0 when release preceded revokeGrant in same tx
